answer:
The official 2026 pricing policy (effective June 1, 2026) fully supersedes and replaces the deprecated 2025 pricing proposal [NL-003#NL-003-S08]. The deprecated 2025 proposal listed: Starter at $900/month with $1,500 onboarding; Growth at $2,800/month with $4,500 onboarding; Enterprise from $6,000/month with from $10,000 onboarding [NL-004#NL-004-S02]. The current 2026 schedule increases these rates as follows:

- **Starter Plan**: Increased from $900/month to $1,200/month; onboarding fee adjusted from $1,500 to $2,500 [NL-004#NL-004-S05].
- **Growth Plan**: Increased from $2,800/month to $3,600/month; onboarding fee adjusted from $4,500 to $7,500 [NL-004#NL-004-S05].
- **Enterprise Plan**: Starting rate increased from $6,000/month to $8,500/month; onboarding fee adjusted from $10,000 to a minimum of $15,000 [NL-004#NL-004-S05].

The deprecated 2025 rates were rejected due to unsustainable infrastructure costs, OCR/PDF processing overhead, permission mapping complexity, and support escalations, as documented in the financial variance audit [NL-004#NL-004-S04]. The official 2026 policy is the sole source of truth for all sales, renewals, and negotiations [NL-003#NL-003-S01]. Legacy contracts under 2025 rates must migrate to 2026 rates upon renewal, though customers may run out their current active term [NL-004#NL-004-S05] [NL-003#NL-003-S08]. The deprecated document is explicitly retired and must not be quoted [NL-004#NL-004-S01].
